core_categories: Laboratory Equipment; Chemicals and Reagents; Consumables and Disposables; Safety and Cleanroom Supplies; Life Sciences and Clinical Tools
specialty_focus: Fisher Scientific is a premier global distributor of laboratory equipment, chemicals, consumables, and safety supplies, serving research, biotech, clinical, education, and industrial facilities. It operates as a master distributor for thousands of principal manufacturers, including Bio-Techne, Harvard Bioscience, and DuPont Personal Protection. While it distributes clinical diagnostic tools, it does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
